user.title: PowerEngine
user.description: PowerEngine runs its engine as a process of Home Assistant. Live: the engine in control, which waits while the AppDaemon app is running. Shadow: a second engine on its own copy of the live data, whose entities are separate (sensor.pe_shadow_...) and which sends nothing. Leave the folder empty for the usual one.

options.shadow: Shadow: beside the live PowerEngine, sends nothing

shadow_no_source.title: The shadow run has no settings to copy
shadow_no_source.description: The shadow run copies the live PowerEngine's folder ({live}), which has no config.yaml. Set PowerEngine up first, then use the refresh_shadow service.

engine_protocol.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating PowerEngine
engine_protocol.description: The updated engine and the PowerEngine integration speak different versions of their protocol, so the engine has stopped. Restarting Home Assistant loads the new integration and the engine starts again.

running_in_appdaemon.title: PowerEngine is already running in AppDaemon
running_in_appdaemon.description: Two copies of PowerEngine would both control the inverter, so the engine has not been started. Stop the AppDaemon app (and keep a backup of apps.yaml); the engine starts within a minute of the app stopping.

engine_crashing.title: The PowerEngine engine keeps stopping
engine_crashing.description: The engine has stopped several times in the last quarter of an hour and is being started again after a wait. Download the integration's diagnostics for the engine's last log lines.

engine_files_missing.title: PowerEngine's engine files are missing
engine_files_missing.description: Reinstall PowerEngine from HACS and restart Home Assistant.

restart_engine.name: Restart engine
restart_engine.description: Restart the PowerEngine engine now, for example to start an update that has just been installed.

refresh_shadow.name: Refresh shadow data
refresh_shadow.description: Stop the shadow engine, copy the live PowerEngine's folder afresh, and start it again.
